exercises.heading: 3.1. Exercises

list.item: How is the number $$e$$ defined?

Use a calculator to estimate the values of the limits $$\lim\limits_{h\rightarrow 0}\frac{2.7^{h} - 1}{h}$$ and $$\lim\limits_{h\rightarrow 0}\frac{2.8^{h} - 1}{h}$$ correct to two decimal places. What can you conclude about the value of $$e$$ ?

solution.paragraph: $$e$$ is the number such that $$\lim\limits_{h\rightarrow 0}\frac{e^{ h} - 1}{h} = 1$$ .

list.item: Sketch, by hand, the graph of the function $$f(x) = e^{ x}$$ , paying particular attention to how the graph crosses the $$y$$ -axis. What is the slope of the tangent line at that point?
What types of functions are $$f(x) = e^{ x}$$ and $$g(x) = x^{e}$$ ? Compare the differentiation formulas for $$f$$ and $$g$$ .
Which of the two functions in part (b) grows more rapidly when $$x$$ is large?

list.item: Graph the function $$f(x) = x^{4} - 3x^{3} - 6x^{2} + 7x + 30$$ in the viewing rectangle $$\left\lbrack {- 3,5} \right\rbrack$$ by $$\left\lbrack {- 10,50} \right\rbrack$$ .

Calculate $$g^{\prime}(x)$$ and use this expression to graph $$g^{\prime}$$ . Compare with your sketch in part (b).

51–52 Find the first and second derivatives of the function. Check to see that your answers are reasonable by comparing the graphs of $$f$$ , $$f^{\prime}$$ , and $$f^{''}$$ .

problem.paragraph: The equation of motion of a particle is $$s = t^{3} - 3t$$ , where $$s$$ is in meters and $$t$$ is in seconds. Find

list.item: the velocity and acceleration as functions of $$t$$ ,
the acceleration after $$2$$ s, and
the acceleration when the velocity is $$0$$ .

problem.paragraph: The equation of motion of a particle is $$s = t^{4} - 2t^{3} + t^{2} - t$$ , where $$s$$ is in meters and $$t$$ is in seconds.

list.item: Find the velocity and acceleration as functions of $$t$$ .
Find the acceleration after $$1$$ s.
Graph the position, velocity, and acceleration functions on the same screen.

problem.paragraph: Biologists have proposed a cubic polynomial to model the length $$L$$ of Alaskan rockfish at age $$A$$ :
where $$L$$ is measured in inches and $$A$$ in years. Calculate

solution.paragraph: $$1.718$$ ; at $$12$$ years, the length of the fish is increasing at a rate of $$1.718{in}/{year}$$

problem.paragraph: The number of tree species $$S$$ in a given area $$A$$ in a forest reserve has been modeled by the power function
where $$A$$ is measured in square meters. Find $$S^{\prime}(100)$$ and interpret your answer.
Boyle’s Law states that when a sample of gas is compressed at a constant temperature, the pressure $$P$$ of the gas is inversely proportional to the volume $$V$$ of the gas.

list.item: Suppose that the pressure of a sample of air that occupies $$0.106m^{3}$$ at $$25{}_{}^{}$$ is $$50$$ kPa. Write $$V$$ as a function of $$P$$ .
Calculate $$dV \slash dP$$ when $$P = 50$$ kPa. What is the meaning of the derivative? What are its units?

solution.paragraph: $$- 0.00212$$ ; instantaneous rate of change of the volume with respect to the pressure at $$25{}_{}^{}$$ ; $$m^{3} \slash {kPa}$$

problem.paragraph: Car tires need to be inflated properly because overinflation or underinflation can cause premature tread wear. The data in the table show tire life $$L$$ (in thousands of miles) for a certain type of tire at various pressures $$P$$ (in $${lb} \slash {in}^{2}$$ ).

list.item: Use a calculator or computer to model tire life with a quadratic function of the pressure.
Use the model to estimate $$dL \slash dP$$ when $$P = 30$$ and when $$P = 40$$ . What is the meaning of the derivative? What are the units? What is the significance of the signs of the derivatives?

problem.paragraph: Find the points on the curve $$y = x^{3} + 3x^{2} - 9x + 10$$ where the tangent is horizontal.
For what value of $$x$$ does the graph of $$f(x) = e^{ x} - 2x$$ have a horizontal tangent?
Show that the curve $$y = 2e^{ x} + 3x + 5x^{3}$$ has no tangent line with slope $$2$$ .
Find an equation of the line that is both tangent to the curve $$y = x^{4} + 1$$ and parallel to the line $$32x - y = 15$$ .
Find equations for two lines that are both tangent to the curve $$y = x^{3} - 3x^{2} + 3x - 3$$ and parallel to the line $$3x - y = 15$$ .
At what point on the curve $$y = 1 + 2e^{ x} - 3x$$ is the tangent line parallel to the line $$3x - y = 5$$ ? Illustrate by graphing the curve and both lines.
Find an equation of the normal line to the curve $$y = \sqrt{x}$$ that is parallel to the line $$2x + y = 1$$ .
Where does the normal line to the parabola $$y = x^{2} - 1$$ at the point $$\left( {- 1,0} \right)$$ intersect the parabola a second time? Illustrate with a sketch.

Draw a diagram to show that there are two tangent lines to the parabola $$y = x^{2}$$ that pass through the point $$\left( {0, - 4} \right)$$ . Find the coordinates of the points where these tangent lines intersect the parabola.

list.item: Find equations of both lines through the point $$\left( {2, - 3} \right)$$ that are tangent to the parabola $$y = x^{2} + x$$ .
Show that there is no line through the point $$\left( {2,7} \right)$$ that is tangent to the parabola. Then draw a diagram to see why.

problem.paragraph: Use the definition of a derivative to show that if $$f(x) = 1 \slash x$$ , then $$f^{\prime}(x) = - 1 \slash x^{2}$$ . (This proves the Power Rule for the case $$n = - 1$$ .)
Find the $$n$$ th derivative of each function by calculating the first few derivatives and observing the pattern that occurs.

list.item: $$f(x) = 1 \slash x$$

problem.paragraph: Find a second-degree polynomial $$P$$ such that $$P(2) = 5$$ , $$P^{\prime}(2) = 3$$ , and $$P^{''}(2) = 2$$ .

The equation $$y^{''} + y^{\prime} - 2y = x^{2}$$ is called a differential equation because it involves an unknown function $$y$$ and its derivatives $$y^{\prime}$$ and $$y^{''}$$ . Find constants $$A$$ , $$B$$ , and $$C$$ such that the function $$y = Ax^{2} + Bx + C$$ satisfies this equation. (Differential equations will be studied in detail in Chapter 9.)
Find a cubic function $$y = ax^{3} + bx^{2} + cx + d$$ whose graph has horizontal tangents at the points $$\left( {- 2,6} \right)$$ and $$\left( {2,0} \right)$$ .
Find a parabola with equation $$y = ax^{2} + bx + c$$ that has slope $$4$$ at $$x = 1$$ , slope $$- 8$$ at $$x = - 1$$ , and passes through the point $$\left( {2,15} \right)$$ .
Is $$f$$ differentiable at $$1$$ ? Sketch the graphs of $$f$$ and $$f^{\prime}$$ .
At what numbers is the following function $$g$$ differentiable?
Give a formula for $$g^{\prime}$$ and sketch the graphs of $$g$$ and $$g^{\prime}$$ .

list.item: For what values of $$x$$ is the function $$f(x) = \left| {x^{2} - 9} \right|$$ differentiable? Find a formula for $$f^{\prime}$$ .
Sketch the graphs of $$f$$ and $$f^{\prime}$$ .

problem.paragraph: Where is the function $$h(x) = \left| {x - 1} \right| + \left| {x + 2} \right|$$ differentiable? Give a formula for $$h^{\prime}$$ and sketch the graphs of $$h$$ and $$h^{\prime}$$ .
Find the parabola with equation $$y = ax^{2} + bx$$ whose tangent line at $$(1,1)$$ has equation $$y = 3x - 2$$ .

Suppose the curve $$y = x^{4} + ax^{3} + bx^{2} + cx + d$$ has a tangent line when $$x = 0$$ with equation $$y = 2x + 1$$ and a tangent line when $$x = 1$$ with equation $$y = 2 - 3x$$ . Find the values of $$a$$ , $$b$$ , $$c$$ , and $$d$$ .
For what values of $$a$$ and $$b$$ is the line $$2x + y = b$$ tangent to the parabola $$y = ax^{2}$$ when $$x = 2$$ ?
Find the value of $$c$$ such that the line $$y = \frac{3}{2}x + 6$$ is tangent to the curve $$y = c\sqrt{x}$$ .
What is the value of $$c$$ such that the line $$y = 2x + 3$$ is tangent to the parabola $$y = cx^{2}$$ ?

The graph of any quadratic function $$f(x) = ax^{2} + bx + c$$ is a parabola. Prove that the average of the slopes of the tangent lines to the parabola at the endpoints of any interval $$\left\lbrack {p,q} \right\rbrack$$ equals the slope of the tangent line at the midpoint of the interval.
Find the values of $$m$$ and $$b$$ that make $$f$$ differentiable everywhere.
Find numbers $$a$$ and $$b$$ such that the given function $$g$$ is differentiable at $$1$$ .
A tangent line is drawn to the hyperbola $$xy = c$$ at a point $$P$$ as shown in the figure.

list.item: Show that the midpoint of the line segment cut from this tangent line by the coordinate axes is $$P$$ .

Show that the triangle formed by the tangent line and the coordinate axes always has the same area, no matter where $$P$$ is located on the hyperbola. Details A curve, a tangent line, and a triangular region are graphed on the x y coordinate plane. The curve labeled x y = c enters the first quadrant at the top, near the y axis, goes down and to the right through a labeled point P, concave up, veers toward the x axis, and exits near the right extreme of the x axis. A tangent with a negative slope is drawn below the curve from the positive y axis to the positive x axis, intersecting the curve at the labeled point P in the first quadrant. A triangular region, bounded by the tangent and both the axes in the first quadrant, is shaded.

problem.paragraph: Draw a diagram showing two perpendicular lines that intersect on the $$y$$ -axis and are both tangent to the parabola $$y = x^{2}$$ . Where do these lines intersect?
Sketch the parabolas $$y = x^{2}$$ and $$y = x^{2} - 2x + 2$$ . Do you think there is a line that is tangent to both curves? If so, find its equation. If not, why not?
If $$c > \frac{1}{2}$$ , how many lines through the point $$\left( {0,c} \right)$$ are normal lines to the parabola $$y = x^{2}$$ ? What if $$c \leqslant \frac{1}{2}$$ ?
